sentences.text: Crocodilaemus was a reptile that lived during the Late Jurassic period.
This animal belongs to the family Teleosauridae, a group of crocodile-like reptiles, and its type species is C. robustus.
The genus Crocodilaemus was first described by Jourdan in 1857.
Fossils of this creature date to the late Kimmeridgian age and were found at the Cerin Lagerstätte in eastern France.
The environment where these fossils were discovered is thought to have been the bottom of a lagoon enclosed by an emergent reef complex.
